nodes.text: Remove person from heat source while looking for signs of burned airway (singed facial/nasal hairs, soot or burns around nose/mouth, black sooty sputum)

evidence.source_text: Remove person from heat source while looking for signs of a burned airway (e.g., singed facial or nasal hairs, soot or burns around or in nose, mouth, black sooty sputum, etc.).

nodes.text: Apply cool, clear water over burned area. Do not soak or use cold water/ice packs (risk of hypothermia)

evidence.source_text: Apply cool, clear water over burned area. Do not soak person or use cold water and ice packs, as this may cause hypothermia.

nodes.text: Examine for other injuries: provide basic first aid, monitor ABCs, treat for shock (keep warm, feet elevated), provide oxygen if available and trained

evidence.source_text: Examine for other injuries. - Provide basic first aid. - Monitor airway, breathing, circulation (ABCs). - Treat for shock by keeping person warm, feet elevated. - Provide oxygen, if available and trained to administer.

nodes.text: Assess degree of burn and area affected: First Degree (Superficial) - red, mild to moderate pain; Second Degree (Partial Thickness) - red/raw, blistered, swollen, painful; Third Degree (Full Thickness) - whitish, charred, or translucent, no pin prick sensation

evidence.source_text: Assess degree of burn and area affected.

nodes.text: Estimate burn area using Rule of Palms: patient's palm = 1% of body surface

evidence.source_text: Rule of Palms: Patient’s palm = 1% of their body surface. Estimate how many times the patient’s palm could be placed over the burned areas to estimate the % of body that has been burned.

nodes.text: Cut away only burned clothing. Do not cut away clothing stuck to burned skin. Remove jewelry near injured area

evidence.source_text: Cut away only burned clothing. Do not cut away clothing stuck to burned skin. Remove jewelry near injured area.

nodes.text: Is burn severe or covering large area of the body?

evidence.source_text: For severe burns or burns covering large area of the body:

nodes.text: Loosely wrap burned area with clean, dry dressing, moisten with clean water, apply dry dressing on top

evidence.source_text: Loosely wrap burned area with clean, dry dressing, and moisten with clean water, and apply dry dressing on top.

nodes.text: Loosely cover burned area with clean, dry dressing. If unavailable, use mylar blankets, plastic wrap, or clean blankets/clothing

evidence.source_text: Loosely cover burned area with clean, dry dressing if available. If dressings are unavailable, mylar blankets, plastic wrap, or clean blankets or clothing can be used.

nodes.text: Keep patient warm and dry. DO NOT use wet dressings or blankets. Avoid hypothermia and overheating

evidence.source_text: Keep patient warm and dry. DO NOT use wet dressings or blankets. Avoid hypothermia and overheating.
